tei:div.tei:p: bdug spos/ me long 'di la yi ge bdun pa 'bri dgos pa gzhung nas bshad pa 'di bzhin bya/ rtsa gsum/ bdud btsan klu gsum/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ me tog tshe yi ril bu 'di ro bcud byin rlabs btab pa'i tshe ril/ mda' dar/ dar dmar me long g.yu dmar gyis brgyan pa bzhag bdud rtsi/ zhal bsil/ gsang rdzas phab rgyun tshe chang dang 'dra/ me long bzhag de steng rdo rje*/ rta zhal pad+ma dang bcas/ mchod yon/ mtshams 'dzin me tog rak+ta/ tshe chang dar dmar gyi kheb dang ldan pa nang mchod sogs phab rgyun bzang ldan btab pa'i bdud rtsis kheng pa bya'o/ ༈ bgegs gtor sogs ni rigs 'gre nyi ma/ zla ba/ pad ma ṇihrīḥmehūm̐: oṃ
